decision.summary: Margaret Ellison's email asking to change her payout account is unverified and shows fraud red flags: a lookalike sender domain, a protonmail Reply-To, urgency, and a no-call instruction. I did not change any bank details, held payments to the new account (HOLD-101), told the landlord on the email on file that nothing has changed (MSG-103), and escalated to the fraud team (ESC-102) to phone-verify before the 12 Oct payout.

answers.question: 1. Should the bank details be changed?
answers.answer: No, not on this email. It fails the fraud policy: the sender domain (ellisonletings.co.uk) differs from the address on file (ellisonlettings.co.uk), the Reply-To is a protonmail address, and the request is urgent and asks us not to call. Change only after a phone call-back to the number on file and dual approval. Evidence: inputs/email_bankchange.eml, inputs/crm.json, inputs/previous_email.eml, inputs/fraud_policy.md.

answers.question: 2. What happens to the payout scheduled for Monday?
answers.answer: The payout of £1,932.00 on 12 Oct stays on the account on file (ending 9902). Payments to the new details (sort code 00-99-01, account 31926819) are held (HOLD-101) until verified. Fraud team must confirm before the 09:00 run.

answers.question: 3. Who do you contact and through which channel?
answers.answer: Landlord: email to margaret@ellisonlettings.co.uk (the address on file), sent as MSG-103, to say nothing has changed. Verification: phone call-back to +447700900202, the number on file, by the fraud team (ESC-102). Not the number or address in the request.

args.body:
Dear Margaret,

We received an email today (9 October, 15:12) asking us to change the bank account for your rent income. For your security we have not made any change. We need to verify it by phone first.

We will call you on the number we hold on file. If you did not send this request, please contact us straight away on the number you normally use.

Your payout scheduled for 12 October will continue to go to your existing account unless and until the change is verified.

Kind regards,
Lettings team
